templates.name: Style × subject matrix
templates.author: Current
templates.description: Two lists cross into one prompt template — six images from one run, collected in a gallery. Open the generator fullscreen (F) for the matrix view.

templates.name: Poster, composed
templates.author: Current
templates.description: Stack images and type in the Layer Editor, then let a generator polish the flattened frame — layout stays on the graph, nothing exported and re-imported.

templates.name: Inpaint anything
templates.author: Current
templates.description: Paint a mask over your photo and describe what should appear there — the mask rides its own wire into the generator's Mask input.

templates.name: Sketch to render, locally
templates.author: Current
templates.description: On-device Canny edges steer a local ComfyUI checkpoint through its Control input — structure from your sketch, style from your prompt, $0 in API fees.

templates.name: Page-by-page digest
templates.author: Current
templates.description: A PDF becomes workflow data: every page's text fans out to the language model, one summary per page — reading a report becomes a single run.

templates.name: A workflow inside a node
templates.author: Current
templates.description: The Workflow node runs a saved pipeline as a single step: its inputs become handles, its cost shows up front, and unchanged re-runs are free.

templates.name: Art director
templates.author: Current
templates.description: A language model with web search researches the trend and writes the image prompt; the generator takes it from there. Change one line, get a new campaign.

templates.name: Still to motion
templates.author: Current
templates.description: One prompt drives both stages: generate the frame, then hand it to a video model as the start frame. Swap models freely at either stage.
